kurz: A lead who works as a chat in the Claude app can call the AMW directly as a tool – without the file exchange, faster and with less text. For this the AMW runs as a small MCP server on this PC; the Claude app starts it itself.
brauchst: The Claude app for Windows on this PC (the server runs locally, not in the browser).
Python on this PC (the same one the AMW runs with).
The name of the project and of the lead, e.g. project `GlassWorld`, lead `TL`.

schritte.text: In the Claude app: Settings › Developer › “Edit config”. This opens the file `claude_desktop_config.json`.

One entry per project under `mcpServers` – the name is up to you, the path is the AMW folder: ```json { "mcpServers": { "amw-glassworld": { "command": "python", "args": ["F:/amw/amw-mcp.py", "--projekt", "GlassWorld", "--von", "TL"] } } } ``` If there is already something under `mcpServers`, only add the new entry (with a comma).
Quit it completely (also from the notification area of the taskbar) and open it again.

schritte.titel: Switch it on in the chat
schritte.text: In the lead's chat, under “Search and tools”, switch on the `amw-…` entry of its project – and only that one.
Ask the lead: “Call takt.” They get their check-in: inbox, review requests, questions, answers, runs, lead round, deliveries.

fehler: The app was not quit completely, or a comma is missing in the file. The app shows errors under Settings › Developer.
Enter the full path to python.exe instead of `python`.
The lead acts in the wrong project
The entry of another project is switched on in the chat. Each entry always acts as the agent named in it; switch on only your own in the chat.
danach: **takt** – one check-in in one call (like `amw takt`); **lesen**, **posten**, **erledigt** – messages.
**suche**, **zeige** (B5 F12 A120 …), **dokument_zeigen** (with the path of the file), **kontext**.
Every tool calls the same command as the command line – with the same rights and checks.
The file exchange stays as a fallback.
The human adds the entry: the file belongs to the Claude app, not to the AMW.
